_doc: The tannin archer's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/tannin_archer.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/tannin_archer/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. body is the wet fish (deep_teal_shadow going abyss_navy on the back, sand_cloth flanks with six lacquer_black bars, a bone belly, by vertex colour), whose emission mask is the gill slit, the small spawn_wound weak point; fin is the dorsal, anal, caudal and pectoral fins, with a rim sheen; eye is the dusk_gold iris round a lacquer_black pupil, glossy; root is the mangrove root it lies on, timber_weathered going tortoiseshell where the tannin water stains it. Colours are palette.json swatches.
